smartteamOutputs.clearRgbLeds: Turn off the RGB LED strip on a SmartTeam shield port.
smartteamOutputs.playNote: Play a musical note on the built-in buzzer.
smartteamOutputs.playTone: Play a tone on the built-in buzzer.
smartteamOutputs.setLed: Turn an external LED on or off.
smartteamOutputs.setLedBrightness: Set external LED brightness with a PWM value from 0 to 1023.
smartteamOutputs.setRgbLed: Set one RGB LED on a SmartTeam shield port with red, green, and blue values.
smartteamOutputs.setRgbLedsColor: Set all RGB LEDs or one RGB LED on a SmartTeam shield port to a preset color.
smartteamOutputs.startMelody: Start a built-in melody on the built-in buzzer.
smartteamOutputs.stopBuzzer: Stop all sounds on the built-in buzzer.
